utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time does the repair drive start, and what should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: It starts at 9, and bring any tools you can spare plus gloves if you’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it - I’ll bring gloves and a few tools.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring over my tool kit if you need a hand with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus. I might take you up on that if I can’t get it sorted.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Appreciate it. I’ll swing by with the toolkit if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard the repair drive’s picking up this week, and folks are saying the morning drop-off got moved to the community hall.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I hope they posted it clearly; I don’t want to show up at the wrong place and miss the whole thing.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, I’d check the notice board at the hall first, and maybe the library too, just to be sure.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can help with that repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, where should we start with the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Let’s start by checking what needs the most urgent fixing, then we can work through the rest step by step.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Uli, I’m putting together the repair drive list now, and I’m telling a few neighbors to come by too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. I can make it over for a bit.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, come by when you can, and I’ll introduce you to the neighbors I’ve invited.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Leo — I’ve got the repair drive organized, and I’ll help you figure out what still needs attention.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Rosa. Point me to the main fixes and I’ll handle the rest.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great — I’ll walk the block with you and point out the biggest repair needs first, then we can tackle the rest together.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I want to check the details first, especially what kind of repair drive you mean.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I mean the neighborhood repair drive we were talking about earlier, the one for fixing up the place. I can fill in the details once I know what you need checked.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it. What specific details do you want me to check first?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with that after I check the school pickup times and see what we can fit in.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Faye. I’ll count on you once you’ve checked, and I’ll keep the repair drive flexible around pickup times.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, I’ll check the pickup times and let you know what I can take on.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive got started, but I only caught that secondhand. What’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s moving along nicely, actually. Folks are signing up for repairs and supplies are getting sorted; I can fill you in on who needs what.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good - point me to the part you want fixed and I'll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you mean the repair drive itself, right?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help if you want to keep it moving. What part of the repair drive needs attention?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I think the brakes are acting up, maybe the left one. I might’ve missed a step, so I could use a hand.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure, I can help with that repair drive. I’ll spread the word and keep the plan moving.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik. I’ll keep an eye on supplies and let you know if we’re short on anything.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely, I’ll keep spreading the word and check back if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive is moving along. I can swing by after errands and see what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, that’d help a lot. I can show you what’s left when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, I’ll head over after these errands and take a look at what’s left.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah, right, the repair drive. I was meaning to bring by my drill, but I forgot it at home. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Just the trim and a couple loose hinges now. If you can swing back with the drill, we can knock it out fast.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I can do that, I just need to grab it from home first. I'll be back in a few minutes.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive. I probably missed the latest change, but I’m here now — what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I need you to take the drill and check the west shelf. Keep it quick.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it, I’ll check the west shelf and keep it quick.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring a drill and a ladder if that helps. Just point me to the first fix.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great. Start with the porch light and the loose hinge by the side door, then we’ll see what else needs attention.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: On it. I’ll start with the porch light and then check that side door hinge.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, I can help with that repair drive. Tell me where you need me most.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Mara. Could you start at the back lot and help sort the tools? I’ll spread the word and point people your way.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, I’ll head to the back lot and start sorting the tools now.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I heard the repair drive is coming together nicely. Do you want me to check what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, please do. I want to know what’s still left and where it needs to happen.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll check what’s still left and where it needs to happen, then I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Cleo. I’ve got the repair drive organized, and I’ll make sure everyone knows where to bring supplies.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll keep track of the supplies and bring what I can.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, thanks, Cleo. I’ll keep the list updated and we’ll make this drive run smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard there was a repair drive, but I’m only getting the updates secondhand. Is there anything you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes, actually. I can use a hand with the list of needed parts and who can pick them up.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Absolutely, I can help with that. Send me the list, and I’ll see who can pick up what.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with that.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks. I can do before school pickup or after drop-off, whichever works better for you.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: After drop-off works for me.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you mean the repair drive for the neighborhood project, right?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, that’s the neighborhood repair drive I meant.
